youtube.title: Why Ice Cubes Crack in Your Drink 🧊 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Ice cubes crack in a drink because of thermal shock. The drink is much warmer than the freezer-cold cube, so the outer layer warms and expands while the core stays cold. The uneven stress splits the ice along weak spots, and each crack makes a snapping sound.
